title: Any signed-in member could delete another member's dataset, and it was a class of defect
symptom: A lab member signed in as an ordinary user and deleted an admin's upload.
root_cause: Ownership was enforced on some mutating endpoints and not others; the audit found the same gap on class renaming and on the two labelling endpoints that spend shared quota.
correction_made: _require_dataset_owner() extracted and applied to delete, classnames, labeling/push and labeling/delete; the delete control rendered only for the uploader or an admin; a positive-and-negative verification matrix run in a real browser.
